tasks.short: Determine the arrangement of chemical operations

steps.what: Define candidate arrangements of mixing, crushing, heat transfer, distillation and drying operations
Calculate comparable balances and performance measures for specified operation arrangements
Check calculations and determine the most effective feasible arrangement of operations

tasks.design: Configure repeatable comparison runs in process simulation software {OTHER} using an engineer-authored specification in {DOCS}. The engineer checks mass and energy consistency, validity and operational trade-offs before recommending an arrangement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Setting up comparable runs and collecting their measures took repeated interaction with calculation tools.
tasks.enabler_now: Native scenario and report functions can repeat specified calculations without interpreting engineering intent.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting plausible arrangements and judging operability remain engineering work.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognizes invalid assumptions and trade-offs hidden by a single performance measure.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated run preparation leaves the engineer's design and recommendation rights unchanged.

reach.task: Compare operational configurations and practical constraints

evidence.claim: Configuring repeated simulation comparisons is plausible deterministic assistance; this arrangement-specific saving is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary includes arrangement design, repeated calculation interaction and recommendation, excluding process installation and experimental work.

The chemical engineer produces in s1 candidate connectivity, feed composition and units, property method, equipment parameters, scenario bounds, comparison measures and convergence checks. Capture and verification remain counted in s1; missing or unsupported inputs require manual setup and review.
OTHER denotes process simulation software. Test native scenario runs and reports before custom code; solver runtime already automatic is excluded from the saved baseline.
Only repeated human setup and result collation in s2 are removed. Independent balance checks, validity assessment and recommendation retain all s3 time.
unknowns: Existing batch configuration and manual setup burden
Validated process models and property data
research_questions: Does native batch configuration reduce repeat setup after input preparation and independent checks?

already_counted.description: Calculation validity checks and arrangement judgement

incremental.description: Maintain comparison specifications and checked templates

approvals.approved_version: Exact arrangement specification, calculation snapshot, checks and recommendation accepted in s3; any change voids acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gross20 minus7 upkeep gives net13. Range0-3 assumes existing partial automation and few comparable arrangements; engineering judgement and solver runtime earn no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop processes for liquid or gas separation or chemically generated electrical currents

tasks.design: Keep process development with the chemical engineer. Existing calculation and documentation tools in {OTHER} and {DOCS} can support development without replacing experimental reasoning or physical investigation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Process development depends on chemistry, experimentation and scale-dependent behavior.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing tools assist specific calculations, but no general automation of developing a workable process is established here.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected behavior and scale-up limitations need engineering investigation.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer forms hypotheses and recognizes when models do not describe the real process.
tasks.altitude: Process development time and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Investigate material behavior under process conditions

evidence.claim: Chemical process development combines physical investigation and engineering judgement; no general automation saving is established by this unchanged design.

assumptions: Boundary is developing the process concept through engineering investigation; a separately enumerated pilot study and arrangement comparison must not be added twice in roll-ups.
The engineer interprets experimental observations directly; no structured process-feasibility flag is assumed.
OTHER denotes process engineering calculation tools. Check native capabilities before custom software; existing computation is not counted as human effort.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new tool, data collection requirement or workflow is introduced.
unknowns: Process novelty and experimental development requirements
research_questions: Is there a repeatable calculation component distinct from development judgement and already counted elsewhere?

incremental.description: No introduced process development automation upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Familiar separation principles and novel electrochemical concepts retain engineering investigation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Interpret laboratory and pilot data and define measurement and control system requirements
Draft measurement descriptions and control logic from the engineering specification

loop.purpose: Draft routine control descriptions and offline logic under the engineer's specification
loop.input: control design specification and independent acceptance tests
loop.output: control design draft with requirement links
loop.check: Engineer checks sensor meaning, units, failure behavior, control responses and independent test results; executable syntax is insufficient
loop.stop: One revision; ambiguous requirements or failed checks return to manual design
loop.why_not_simpler: Native function blocks come first; remaining requirement-specific logic and descriptions need interpretation

steps.what: Validate measurement and control design against independent tests and accept the design version

tasks.design: Use native control engineering libraries in {OTHER} first, then bounded assistance for routine draft logic and descriptions. The engineer retains independent validation and accepts an exact design version in {DOCS}; there is no automatic plant deployment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Translating a settled control specification into routine descriptions and logic required repeated drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Industrial coding assistance can draft control code, subject to engineering checks.
tasks.still_hard: Sensor validity, process response and failure behavior require engineering judgement and independent tests.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides whether the control strategy fits the physical process.
tasks.altitude: Drafting support leaves measurement choices, control strategy and design acceptance with the engineer.

reach.learn: Signal integrity and interface failure modes

evidence.claim: Siemens Industrial Copilot provides PLC and HMI engineering assistance; this supports draft-code capability rather than validated chemical plant control design.
The proposed measurement and control design workflow and its labour estimates are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary covers design from existing laboratory and pilot results, not collecting those results, implementing plant controls or authorizing plant operation.

The chemical engineer produces in s1 process variables, units, sensor ranges, sampling needs, proposed control relationships, operating envelope, failure behavior and independent acceptance cases. Interpretation and capture remain fully counted; missing requirements return to manual design.
OTHER denotes control engineering software. Test native function blocks and reusable descriptions before a model; use draft assistance only for the remaining routine implementation.
Existing laboratory and pilot producers retain their collection work. If this task also includes those studies, assign their effort once rather than treating their data as free new capture.
unknowns: Existing engineering libraries and design validation procedures
Access controls for confidential process data
research_questions: Does checked drafting reduce design preparation after independent response and failure tests?

already_counted.description: Review and correction of proposed logic and descriptions

incremental.description: Maintain requirement templates and independent test cases

approvals.approved_version: Exact specification, measurement selections, logic version and independent validation results accepted in s3; changes void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R86 gross14 minus7 upkeep gives net7. Range0-2 assumes little routine logic beyond existing libraries and substantial correction; physical validation and design judgement retain time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct laboratory and pilot process studies

steps.what: Perform laboratory studies and test proposed manufacturing processes in small-scale physical operations

tasks.design: Keep laboratory studies and pilot trials as physical engineering work. Existing instruments and study records in {OTHER} support observation without making an unverified claim that the investigation itself disappears.
tasks.previous_blocker: New processes need physical evidence under controlled but imperfect conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Instruments can already record measurements; their existing runtime is not a new labour saving.
tasks.still_hard: Unanticipated physical behavior and experimental validity need direct investigation.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer identifies misleading measurements and changes the investigation appropriately.
tasks.altitude: Physical study time and engineering responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Investigate material behavior during process trials
reach.learn: Separating measurement error from material response

evidence.claim: Physical process studies retain experimental work; existing instrument recording does not establish an additional saving.

assumptions: Boundary is the focal engineer's physical laboratory and pilot investigation; study reporting or repeat calculation should be measured separately if present.
The chemical engineer produces observations and pilot findings during s1. No structured successful-trial or safe-process flag is assumed.
OTHER denotes laboratory and pilot instrumentation. Test native capture before custom software without counting existing automatic measurement as human baseline.
Zero upkeep because no new study automation is introduced. Assign any overlap with general process development once in team roll-ups.
unknowns: Physical study protocols and existing instrument capture
research_questions: Is repeated transcription a separately measured burden outside the physical study?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 minus0 upkeep gives net0. Routine pilot studies and unexpected experimental behavior retain physical investigation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Repeat calculation and draft logic may shrink while process design, physical studies and independent validation remain with the engineer.
reach: Review control interfaces with electrical engineers
Investigate material behavior with materials engineers
role.ambitious_version: A chemical engineer spending less time on repeated setup and routine drafts while retaining physical and engineering judgement.
